A 26-seater e-rickshaw? A vehicle covering 22,708 km in just 25 hours? Questions over government spending in Madhya Pradesh have raised serious concerns about billing irregularities and public money.
At a conference in Ujjain titled *Mahakal: The Master of Time*, vehicle rental bills worth over ₹57 lakh came under scrutiny. According to media reports, discrepancies were flagged in vehicle registration numbers, extra-duty charges and odometer readings.
